title: Relatedness (v2 envelope)
description: One entry per profiled company; each focal ticker's peers are fetched separately (PEERS_URL).

schema_version.description: the envelope's own version, not the store's _SCHEMA_VERSION

board.description: the dashboard's module key for this board

run_id.description: the dashboard job that wrote it (rawstore.writer_run_id)

data_asof.description: this board carries an as-of; the door refuses an envelope without one

built_at.description: when this file was written, UTC ISO

private.description: true: never to the AI chat, a mock, a fixture or a log

layout.description: the generic renderers' description; null until step 8

data.description: the board's payload, exactly as /view/<board>/payload.json serves it
